description: Created a three-stage hybrid network: (1) Shell sort with large gaps (≥4) for efficient initial long-distance comparisons, (2) Reduced odd-even passes (n/2 instead of n) for systematic neighboring element sorting, (3) Limited bubble sort cleanup (4 passes max) for final guarantee. This combines shell sort's gap efficiency, odd-even's parallelizable structure, and bubble sort's reliability while reducing redundant comparisons between stages.
notes: Valid sorting network with 141 comparators, depth 32, passed all 75536 tests
